description: Proves a SimpleX message was successfully sent to an exact address

judges.description: TRUE if evidence contains simplex_send class with valid message_id, to address, body_hash, and sent_at timestamp

gates.description: Evidence must be within freshness window

critical_rules: The adapter's send acknowledgement is evidence only, not proof
Independent readback of message delivery status is required for TRUE
If send succeeds but readback is unavailable, actuality is UNKNOWN
The exact destination address must match the claim subject
